Priya A. (AE): Urgent: VentureCare board needs confirmation on BYOK, encryption-at-rest, and EU egress pricing before sign-off today.

Marco R. (Solutions): BYOK supported for Private; hosted supports KMS integration but limited attestations. Egress: intra-EU cheaper, cross-region billed per GB. Will draft quick comparisons.

Li Wei (Eng): For dedicated in eu-west-1 with private peering, estimated p95 ~120ms for ~2k qps at 60 tokens avg. Can run a short perf job.

Tanya G. (Legal): We can do BYOK addendum and KMS audit log clause. HSM attestation requires evidence from customer and may add ~2 business days.

Sam S. (SRE): Network: peering usually 5 business days; VPN + allowlist possible in ~48h. Mutual TLS needs certs from their infra.

Priya A. (AE): Board wants "no blockers" by COB. Can we offer a 2-week dedicated trial as exec fallback?

Finance-bot: Quote request received (priority). Will provide trial pricing + 12mo reserved delta in ~3h.

Marco R. (Solutions): I'll post a 1-pager + pricing spreadsheet with BYOK attestation surcharge in ~2h.

Omar C. (CS): I'll own onboarding runbook for the trial (peering steps, certs, rollback).

Priya A. (AE): Action items: Marco=pricing+1pager, Li=perf run, Tanya=legal addendum, Sam=network runbook, Omar=onboarding. Meet 3pm to finalize.

Priya A. (AE): Filing infra ticket now and asking VentureCare to send Azure Key Vault attestation + cert contact.

(END)
